title: staggered-regional-quarantine-orchestrator-with-soft-quota-reintegration
author: Maya Chen
body:
Context and motivation: In prior incidents we observed large tenant-initiated spikes that caused immediate regional SLO tripping and aggressive tenant quarantine that was difficult to recover from (tenant remained in hard lockdown and required manual intervention). This change implements a Staggered Regional Quarantine Orchestrator that applies soft quotas, timed probation windows, and phased reintegration to reduce blast radius while keeping tail-latency SLOs protected.

Design summary: The orchestrator introduces three stages for a tenant/route when regional pressure is detected: 1) soft-quota (rate-dampening + priority decay) applied per-tenant; 2) probationary reintegration window with gradual token allowance increases and adaptive KV cache warming; 3) full reinstate when regional health metrics (p95 latency, GPU util, queue length) stabilize for a configurable epoch. The orchestration is coordinated across control-plane replicas to avoid split-brain using an optimistic lease with epoch numbers (non-blocking).

Behavioral details (single-string): Soft-quota enforces an adjustable per-tenant request weight without cutting connections; the circuit-breaker remains engaged but now in a non-terminal "soft" state that reduces priority and token allowance. Probation windows use an exponential warmup schedule with jitter to avoid synchronized reintegrations across tenants. Reintegration is scoped by slot groups so high-priority tenants are warmed earlier. We also added a short-term sticky-penalty for tenants that re-offend inside probation to prevent oscillation. The orchestrator consults SLO-enforcer signals and regional admission controllers; if SLOs worsen during probation we auto-escalate to full quarantine.

Implementation notes: - New module: services/quarantine/orchestrator.go (controller + lease management + coordinator client) and services/quarantine/slot_manager.go (slot allocation and warmup scheduling). - Runtime flag: --enable-staggered-quarantine (off by default) and experimental configs under configs/experimental/quarantine.yaml. - Telemetry: new metrics quarantine_stage{stage}, probation_reinstate_attempts, reinstate_success_ratio; added trace spans quarantine.orchestrator.*. - Tests: unit tests for slot allocation and lease contention; integration harness simulating regional pressure via perf-canary.

Rollout plan: 1) merge behind feature flag; 2) enable in canary region for 48h with aggressive telemetry alerts; 3) gradual ramp to 25% regions with traffic rules for high-priority tenants excluded; 4) full enable if no regressions.

Checklist: - [x] Unit tests written and passing - [x] Integration scenario in perf-canary configured - [x] Metrics dashboards updated (Grafana link in comments) - [x] Feature gated behind runtime flag - [x] Docs snippet for ops runbook added

Risks and mitigations: Risk of improperly tuned probation windows causing long tail effects; mitigation: conservative defaults and automatic backoff to full quarantine. Risk of control-plane lease contention; mitigation: optimistic lease with bounded retries.

Related: This complements ENG-1207 (tenant fairness) and the incident postmortem SUP-4123.
commits: a1f3d7d: introduce orchestrator core and slot manager
b2e4c89: add metrics, traces, and config schema for staggered quarantine
c3d5a12: unit/integration tests and ops runbook update
review_comments: Carlos Vega: Can the probation warmup schedule be simplified to a linear ramp for predictable token math? Concern: exponential + jitter may be hard to reason about in SLAs.
Maya Chen: Replied: We kept exponential for quick early ramping then linear tail; added comment and tunable parameter so ops can switch to linear ramp if desired.
Anya Patel: Please add a safety valve that prevents more than N tenants entering probation simultaneously to avoid coordinated reintegration spikes.
Maya Chen: Added slot manager cap (config: max_concurrent_reinstate) and associated tests.
Ravi Menon: CI flaked on one integration test (timing). Please add retry/backoff to the test harness to reduce noise.
Maya Chen: Updated the perf-canary harness test to use a deterministic clock in this scenario and added one retry on transient failures.
ci_checks: Benchmarks (local): warnings: small regression in worst-case reinstate path (-2%); within expected range
release_notes: Introduce a staged regional quarantine orchestrator behind a feature flag. Adds soft quotas, probationary reintegration windows, and slot-based warmup to minimize manual recovery after regional pressure events. Telemetry and dashboards added. Feature disabled by default.
